'Didn’t even take five minutes': Man uses ChatGPT to find lost earbud hidden in gravel

A Reddit user claims ChatGPT helped him find a missing white earbud hidden among gravel at a park in less than five minutes by analysing uploaded photos. The incident sparked discussion about AI’s image recognition capabilities and its potential to solve everyday problems.
